title: Exchange Online Archiving & Messaging Retention (Archive Mailboxes, EOA & Holds)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Give mailboxes archiving and holds without the mailbox bloat
problem: Growing mailboxes, PST sprawl, and litigation exposure all point to mailbox archiving. This solution implements Exchange Online Archiving specifically: enable archive mailboxes and auto-expanding archive, move-to-archive via archive/retention tags (MRM), import PSTs to the archive, and apply litigation hold and in-place/eDiscovery holds where required — so mailbox size is controlled and messaging data is preserved and discoverable. (Scoped to email archiving/holds; broader Purview DLP/labels/retention is a separate concern.)
whats_inside: Solution Overview — archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, MRM archive/retention tags & policies, PST import, and litigation/in-place hold — and how this differs from Purview DLP/sensitivity-label work.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + archiving-capable licensing, admin roles, PST source if any, legal/records stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — enable archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, build MRM archive/retention tags and a policy, import PSTs to the archive, and apply litigation/in-place holds — pilot-first, each policy/tag named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (archives provisioned, move-to-archive working, holds enforced) plus Best Practices; legal-hold determinations deferred to legal/records.
short: Implement Exchange Online Archiving specifically — archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, MRM archive/retention tags, PST import, and litigation/in-place holds — so mailbox size is controlled and messaging data is preserved and discoverable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
